answer: Each new identity posts a 50-unit bond and pays 5 units of rent per epoch, and weight accrues only after the bond survives one island, 30 days of graded work with no failed audit. Peers verify the newcomer by checking its atlas, 50 graded answers linked in the public ledger, and any gap longer than 7 days forfeits the whole bond. A karst of 20 consecutive passes is required before the bond unlocks, so 100 fakes must post 5,000 units and survive 100 separate 30-day islands of unbroken work.
